name: @absolutejs/runtime
description: Multi-tenant Bun runtime substrate for PaaS providers — spawn isolated child Bun processes per tenant, idle-kill, metric emit. The library SB-6 surfaces between isolated-jsc + sync and the hosted product downstream.
author: Alex Kahn

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --sourcemap --target=bun && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check:package: bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run test
scripts.release: bun run format && bun run check:package && bun publish
